text:
Rina (Partnerships): EdgeWorks just confirmed interest in listing Redwood on their APAC-orbit marketplace. They want a joint launch playbook + a pilot with telemetry integration.
Noah (Partnerships): Nice. what's their requested capacity and timeline?
Rina (Partnerships): They asked for 14 reserved GPUs + burst 56 for 30 days. target soft-launch window is month-end. They want quota metrics pushed to their billing webhook and a marketplace SKU.
Ken (Cloud Ops): 14 reserved is doable but needs a separate nodepool in apac-orbit1. estimate: 4 business days including AMI bake. Also need permission to push marketplace AMI and a network path for webhook.
Ava (SRE): We'll need to add region-specific SLIs and a canary plan. propose a 36h canary: 6h smoke, 30h soak. Who's running SI tests? EdgeWorks SI partner (BlueForge) wants a 48h integration window.
Rina (Partnerships): EdgeWorks pasted their sku suggestion:
```
sku: redwood-inference.apac.orbit.v1
reserved: 14
burst: 56
billing_feed: webhook-v2
kms: redwood-managed-ok
```
Noah (Partnerships): They also require signed attestation for certified driver (EdgeX-accelerator) on AMI. EdgeWorks indicated driver distribution via partner portal (NDA).
Ken (Cloud Ops): driver = additional kernel module + userspace libs. I'll need vendor creds to pull binaries and bake AMI. ETA bumps to 6 days if NDA gating.
Diego (Legal): NDA + attestation: we can sign a limited attestation that we baked driver into AMI and ran validation tests. I'll draft the attestation language and request vendor contact from EdgeWorks PM. Also need webhook terms for billing data.
EdgeWorks PM: paging in their PM: we can grant vendor portal access and will send staging creds by EOD. embargo: prefer 10-day pre-press hold.
Ava (SRE): for billing webhook, we need a schema. EdgeWorks, can you share expected event shape?
EdgeWorks PM: will share schema and sample events in the staging pack.
OrbitBot: ticket #PRT-4012 created: "EdgeWorks APAC-Orbit Marketplace Onramp" assigned to Rina, Ken, Ava. ETA infra: 6 days if NDA access delayed.
Noah (Partnerships): next steps: Rina to collect vendor portal link + EdgeWorks legal contact; Ken to open infra PR for nodepool & AMI bake; Ava to add SLIs, canary runbook, and test webhook; Diego to draft attestation + webhook terms. Sync Tues 09:00 SGT.
Ken (Cloud Ops): potential blocker: EdgeX-accelerator driver license requires signed redistributor agreement; will escalate if portal access doesn't arrive today.
Rina (Partnerships): I'll escalate to EdgeWorks ops and ask for a 7-day capacity hold on the 14 reserved GPUs.
Ava (SRE): if hold approved, we can hit the soft-launch window; otherwise push by two weeks.
Diego (Legal): I'll prepare a minimal attestation template and post it here. Also will need to review webhook PII considerations.
EdgeWorks PM: will send vendor creds + schema by EOD and confirm capacity hold. looking forward to the pilot.
Rina (Partnerships): great, thanks everyone. I'll post updates when vendor creds arrive. :rocket:
